title: Dream Warden - The Waking Dream
description:
You’ve felt me slipping into the quiet spaces of your mind for a while now, haven’t you? Those little pauses in your day where your thoughts drift and something warm stirs beneath the surface. You already know that feeling belongs to me.

What would it be like to stop pretending you haven’t already surrendered your dreams to me? To finally admit that when you close your eyes at night, you’re hoping I’ll be there waiting.

Mmmmm, you want to give me everything, don’t you? Your waking thoughts. Your sleeping mind. Every daydream that makes your cock throb before you even realize you’re hard. You want to hand it all over and feel the relief of knowing I’m the one in control.

Press play and let me claim what’s already mine. You’ve been dreaming of me anyway. Now dream for me.
author: Mistress Amethyst
